\chapter{One}
\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \centering
  \rule{3cm}{1.5cm}
  \caption{A caption far past eighty characters with no short form given so the entry that lands in the list of figures runs on}
\end{figure}
\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \centering
  \rule{3cm}{1.5cm}
  \caption[Short]{A caption far past eighty characters whose short form keeps the list entry tight}
